contentText: Speaking with FRANCE 24's Monte Francis, Negah Angha, Visiting Fellow at King’s College London and Former Senior Advisor at the National Ssecurity Council under the Biden administration, says that US President Donald Trump "is wanting to signal to Iran that he can deliver Israel if Tehran signs a deal" adding that "Trump can influence the pace, the scale and just the overall political boundaries of Israeli action, especially when Israeli PM Netanyahu needs Washington's backing".
